# Agal Boutique
> Women's boutique in Tamil Nadu, India: handcrafted sarees, pure cotton kurtis, festive lehengas, custom-stitched blouses and kidswear, shipped across India.

## Key collections and pages
- [Home](https://www.agalboutique.com/): Latest weaves, curated categories, and studio story
- [Shop all collections](https://www.agalboutique.com/shop): Full catalogue with size, fabric, and occasion filters
- [Sarees](https://www.agalboutique.com/shop?category=sarees): Kanchipuram silks, cotton handlooms, festive party sarees
- [Kurtis](https://www.agalboutique.com/shop?category=kurtis): Pure cambric cotton, rayon, and office wear kurtis
- [Blouses & Custom Stitching](https://www.agalboutique.com/shop?category=blouses): Readymade padded blouses and 3–5 day custom stitching
- [Shipping and returns](https://www.agalboutique.com/): Nationwide delivery within 3–7 business days, 7-day easy returns
- [WhatsApp Support](https://wa.me/919876543210): Instant stylist enquiry and order assistance
